provenance: Reported Voron Trident misdetection rig from debug bundle TZT85MQ3: shipped as 'FlashForge Adventurer 5M Pro'
notes: hostname 'vt-1899' contains neither 'voron' nor 'trident', so every Voron hostname heuristic misses.
No led_effect config: it matches the AD5M Pro pattern 'chamber_l' through a plain 'output_pin Chamber_Light', a name any enclosed custom build uses.
Three Z steppers plus z_tilt and no quad_gantry_level is the Trident signature; the AFC/BoxTurtle and lane sensors are real-rig noise.
